zh.title: 同一件事，群聊和 PR 应该怎样表达？
zh.lead: 切换渠道与任务方向；对话窗口改变，任务身份和执行记录仍连续。
zh.diagramLabel: 同一任务在三个渠道的不同输出
zh.b: 方案 B：修复状态管理
zh.internal:
复现登录失败 → 比较重试和状态修复 → 修改代码 → 测试。
这些推理和工具调用日志保留在执行 Session。
zh.initial: 先等待事件；没有向任何渠道真实发消息。
zh.imA: 已按方案 A 准备登录重试修复，测试通过。请审阅 PR；确认后再合并。
zh.imB: 已根据 PR 评论切换到方案 B，修复状态管理并重新测试。需要你确认行为是否符合预期。
zh.prA:
问题：登录偶发失败。
变更：采用方案 A，增加暂态错误重试。
验证：教学情境中的登录用例通过。
待确认：重试策略和回退行为；尚待审阅。
zh.prB:
问题：原重试方案没有处理状态根因。
变更：根据评论改用方案 B，修复状态管理。
验证：重新执行教学回归用例。
待确认：行为变化与合并许可。
zh.emailA:
主题：登录修复方案 A 待审阅

背景与变更：为暂态登录错误增加重试。
验证摘要：演示用例通过。
下一步：请在 PR 中评审重试策略。
zh.emailB:
主题：登录修复已按评审切换到方案 B

背景与变更：根据 PR 意见修复状态管理。
验证摘要：重新运行演示回归用例。
下一步：请确认行为与合并决定。
zh.intervene: 中途介入：PR 要求方案 B
zh.cancelled: ■ 用户取消；保持任务记录，不把已准备内容继续当作交付结果。
zh.caption: 渠道决定表达形式；它不应决定任务是否丢失上下文，也不必与执行 Session 一一对应。
zh.limit0: 全部消息是本地演示草稿。此页不连接 IM、邮件或 GitHub，也不发送任何消息。
zh.limit1: 文章的群聊短回复上限是其交互经验，不是 Harness 或全部渠道的硬性系统限制。
zh.limit2: 隐藏 Session 后的任务管理和实时接管仍是开放产品问题；本页只给一个教学设计。
zh.question: 用户在 PR 改方案，是否必须重新开始一个完全无关的聊天任务？
zh.answer: 不必。关联同一任务后，反馈可以进入对应 Worker；Router 保持统一交互，执行器继续使用任务记录。
zh.step0Explanation: 用户从已有工作环境发起请求；Worker 的执行细节不直接灌入公共渠道。
zh.step1Explanation: 同一个执行任务可以接收来自不同关联 Thread 的反馈。切换渠道只是改变对外草稿。
zh.step2Explanation: 点击中途介入，把方案 B 反馈关联到当前任务。取消是另一种决定，不能等同于验收。
zh.step3Title: 按渠道交付并等待验收
zh.step3Explanation: 群聊给短结论；PR 给背景、变更和验证；邮件组织为可审阅草稿。
zh.source0: 原型：向主 Session 转交信息
zh.progressA: 已记录方案 A，后台调查与验证仍在进行；这不是完成报告。
zh.progressB: 已记录方案 B，正在按新方向重新检查；尚未确认测试结果。

en.simulation: Teaching model · No real agents or external commands
en.codeNote: Below: source excerpts or explicitly labeled design summaries. Interactive scenarios are illustrative.

en.title: How should the same work appear in chat and a PR?
en.lead: Switch channel and task direction. The conversation surface changes while task identity and execution records remain continuous.
en.diagramLabel: Different outputs for one task across three channels
en.internal:
Reproduce login failure → compare retries and state handling → edit → test.
Reasoning and tool logs remain in the execution session.
en.initial: Waiting for an event. No message is actually sent to any channel.
en.imA: Plan A is ready: login retries updated and tests pass. Please review the PR before merging.
en.imB: I switched to plan B after the PR comment, fixed state handling, and reran tests. Please confirm the intended behavior.
en.prA:
Problem: intermittent login failure.
Change: plan A adds transient retries.
Validation: the fictional login test passes.
Review needed: retry policy and fallback behavior.
en.prB:
Problem: retries did not address the state-handling cause.
Change: plan B fixes state handling after review feedback.
Validation: rerun the fictional regression cases.
Review needed: behavior change and permission to merge.
en.emailA:
Subject: login fix, plan A ready for review

Background and change: retry transient login failures.
Validation summary: demo cases pass.
Next step: review the retry policy in the PR.
en.emailB:
Subject: login fix updated to plan B after review

Background and change: fix state handling per PR feedback.
Validation summary: demo regressions rerun.
Next step: confirm behavior and decide on merging.
en.intervene: Intervene: request plan B in the PR
en.cancelled: ■ User cancelled. Retain records and stop treating prepared content as a deliverable.
en.caption: Channels shape presentation. They need not determine context continuity or map one-to-one to execution sessions.
en.limit0: Every message is a local demo draft. The page does not connect to or send messages through IM, email, or GitHub.
en.limit1: The article’s short-chat reply cap is an interaction convention, not a universal Harness or channel limit.
en.limit2: Task management and live takeover with hidden sessions remain open product questions. This is one teaching design.
en.question: Must a plan change in a PR start a wholly unrelated task?
en.answer: No. Once related to the same task, feedback can reach its Worker. The Router keeps interaction consistent while the executor retains task records.
en.step0Explanation: The user requests work in an existing channel. Worker execution details do not flood that channel.
en.step1Explanation: One task can receive feedback from several related Threads. Switching channels changes only the outward draft.
en.step2Explanation: Intervene to relate plan B to the current work. Cancellation is a different decision from acceptance.
en.step3Title: Deliver for the channel and await sign-off
en.step3Explanation: Chat gets a short conclusion; a PR gets background, changes, and validation; email gets a reviewable draft.
en.source0: Prototype: relay to the main Session
en.progressA: Plan A is recorded. Background investigation and validation are still in progress; this is not a completion report.
en.progressB: Plan B is recorded. Work is being rechecked in the new direction; test results are not yet confirmed.
